queries.compute:
WITH compute_view AS (
    SELECT c.globalTaskId, ROUND(t.endNs - t.startNs) AS duration_ns, n.value AS op_name, type_str.value AS op_type
    FROM COMPUTE_TASK_INFO c
    LEFT JOIN TASK t ON t.globalTaskId = c.globalTaskId
    LEFT JOIN STRING_IDS n ON n.id = c.name
    LEFT JOIN STRING_IDS type_str ON type_str.id = c.opType
)
SELECT json_group_array(json_array(t.startNs,t.endNs,t.streamId)) FROM compute_view c JOIN TASK t ON t.globalTaskId=c.globalTaskId
queries.rs: SELECT json_group_array(json_array(o.startNs,o.endNs)) FROM COMMUNICATION_OP o JOIN STRING_IDS n ON n.id=o.opType WHERE n.value='hcom_reduceScatter_'
queries.event_markers: SELECT json_group_array(json_array(CAST(p.startNs AS INTEGER),CAST(p.endNs AS INTEGER),p.globalTid,n.value)) FROM PYTORCH_API p JOIN STRING_IDS n ON n.id=p.name WHERE n.value LIKE 'dep/E%'
queries.event_apis: SELECT json_group_array(json_array(a.startNs,a.endNs,a.globalTid,a.connectionId,n.value)) FROM CANN_API a JOIN STRING_IDS n ON n.id=a.name WHERE n.value IN ('aclrtRecordEvent','aclrtStreamWaitEvent','aclrtSynchronizeEvent')
queries.all_tasks: SELECT json_group_array(json_array(t.startNs,t.endNs,t.streamId,t.connectionId,n.value,t.taskId)) FROM TASK t JOIN STRING_IDS n ON n.id=t.taskType
queries.main_compute_launches:
WITH compute_view AS (
    SELECT c.globalTaskId, ROUND(t.endNs - t.startNs) AS duration_ns, n.value AS op_name, type_str.value AS op_type
    FROM COMPUTE_TASK_INFO c
    LEFT JOIN TASK t ON t.globalTaskId = c.globalTaskId
    LEFT JOIN STRING_IDS n ON n.id = c.name
    LEFT JOIN STRING_IDS type_str ON type_str.id = c.opType
)
SELECT json_group_array(json_array(t.startNs,t.endNs,h.startNs,h.endNs)) FROM compute_view c JOIN TASK t ON t.globalTaskId=c.globalTaskId LEFT JOIN CANN_API h ON h.connectionId=t.connectionId AND h.name IN (SELECT id FROM STRING_IDS WHERE value='launch') WHERE t.streamId=1084

Dependency-derived pending ranges are inferred from labeled in-order stream semantics and recorded command boundaries, not measured task durations.
No captured producer for pre-capture or internal C++ events is not proof of no dependency.
